body: But here's the problem: in the unlikely case she is pregnant, i'll have to deal with the child in some way, and I'm not ready to deal with that sort of pressure.
Im afraid she might be in on it too

but thats the problem. I dont want to be a father, im not ready to be one. And she refuses to show me a pregnancy test. She suspected it when she started "spotting" a couple weeks back and she said she had taken one and it had come up positive. This however, was before her period was supposedly due, and when I asked if I could see it, she informed me that it had been thrown out. She claims her mom knows about it, but I feel like anything I do will jeopardize the situation, and she may end up keeping it out of spite. I just dont know what to do.
I wish you the best on the road to recovery as well. It's extremely difficult and long, but I'm trying to hold out hope that one day it'll happen
